metrics: instantaneous peak Strehl, corrected and uncorrected
definition.saturation_definition: per frame, the fraction of DM actuators whose requested command magnitude exceeds the 1 um OPD stroke limit and is clipped (dm.model: mean(|requested| > stroke_limit_opd_m))
definition.statistics: per non-overlapping 100-frame (100 ms) block: mean, standard deviation, min, max; saturation also the share of frames with any clipped actuator
definition.declared: descriptive only; no stationarity test and no window tuning

notice: Descriptive statistics of one realization of each case.  The 200-frame startup exclusion is a predeclared analysis window, not evidence of convergence; block-to-block drift and fluctuations are reported as observed. One second does not establish stationarity or a converged long exposure.
